newsitem.title: UK: L-Bank prices mark and French franc Eurobonds.
newsitem.headline: L-Bank prices mark and French franc Eurobonds.

text.p: Baden Wuerttemberg L-Finance NV has priced two seven-year Eurobonds, a 750 million mark deal at a 10 basis points spread and a 2.0 billion French franc deal at 14 b.p. over, joint lead manager J.P. Morgan said on Thursday.
Guaranteed by L-Bank, the deals will be redenominated in euros after EMU after which they will be fungible, creating a euro Eurobond. The two deals are worth around 690 million Ecu.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell is joint lead manager of the mark bond and Caisse des Depots et Consignations joint lead on the franc bond.
